sleep-stage-page.title:
Get ready for the next stage! 
 Instruction for All Players:

2.title: Fascists and Hitler, open your eyes and acknowledge each other

1.title: Close your eyes and make a fist
1.content: (Hold your fist in front of you until everyone is ready.)

2.title: Fascists (NOT Hitler), open your eyes
2.content: (Acknowledge each other silently while keeping track of the thumbs-up.)

3.title: Hitler, show your thumb
3.content: (Keep your eyes closed but extend your thumb for Fascists to recognize.)

4.title: Everyone close your eyes and lower your hands
4.content: (Pause for a moment before moving on.)

5.title: Open your eyes
5.content: (If anything is unclear or went wrong, speak up now.)
